resources.string: Enter the device name shown on your ESP32 node display to establish a secure offline link.
This application operates entirely offline using secure localized peer-to-peer networks. Your credentials will be stored safely on local nodes without internet dependencies.

PIGEON (Private Encrypted Network Communication) is a decentralized emergency messaging platform designed to facilitate secure communication during natural disasters and network outages. Operating over autonomous ESP32 hotspots and LoRa mesh networks, it ensures vital connections remain active when traditional infrastructures fail.

PIGEON Node devices integrate high-performance ESP32 microcontrollers with long-range Semtech LoRa transceivers and secure local storage models. These elements form a self-healing mesh topology designed for maximum off-grid reliability.

By accessing the decentralized PIGEON network, you agree to participate in an offline peer-to-peer framework. All data is transmitted securely via local RF links. The system hosts no centralized tracking, and encryption keys remain exclusively under user custody.
For administrative support, custom node firmware inquiries, or emergency response deployment guides, contact the Project PIGEON research desk.
